description: The image displays a line drawing titled "Diagram 1 Direct connection of ground floor WC to a drain". On the left, the side profile of a toilet is shown with a pipe exiting its rear. This pipe bends downwards, runs horizontally to the right, and terminates with a slight upward slope. A thick horizontal line represents the floor on which the toilet sits, and a thinner line to the right marks the "Floor level". At the bottom right, the text "Invert of drain" indicates the bottom of the horizontal section of the pipe. A vertical dimension line with arrows connects the "Floor level" line to the "Invert of drain", labeled with the measurement "1.3m max."
